latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Video Editing Online.

- Instantly edit and export raw video clips by simply describing your needs—no manual timelines or export settings.
- Cloud editing backend handles uploads, trimming, music, aspect ratio, overlays, and exports in 1080p MP4 by default.
- Guided setup process: automatic token handling, secure connection, and clear status updates.
- Supports file uploads up to 500MB in popular video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM).
- Built-in keyword and intent matching for fast access to common actions like export, credits, and status.
- Handy error handling, session management, and user-friendly prompts throughout the workflow.
